- name: Source-bootstrap host self-host gate
        run: bash scripts/codex/action-source-bootstrap-host-gate.sh
      - name: Execute x86 generic and imported aggregate ABI regressions
        run: bash scripts/ci/bootstrap_generic_array_layout_gate.sh /tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-selfhost-linux-x86_64/artifacts/souc-stage2
      - name: Cross-build macOS arm64 compiler artifact
        run: |
          SOUC_STAGE2=/tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-selfhost-linux-x86_64/artifacts/souc-stage2
          MACOS_OUT=/tmp/souc-self-hosted-arm64-macos
          "$SOUC_STAGE2" self-hosted/compiler/lean_single.sio "$MACOS_OUT" --target aarch64-macos
          chmod +x "$MACOS_OUT"
          file "$MACOS_OUT" | grep -E "Mach-O 64-bit.*arm64.*executable|Mach-O 64-bit.*executable.*arm64"
      - name: Cross-compile ARM64 nested-store witness
        env:
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_COMPILER: /tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-selfhost-linux-x86_64/artifacts/souc-stage2
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_DIR: /tmp/sounio-arm64-nested-store-witness
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_MODE: attest
        run: bash scripts/ci/arm64_nested_store_witness_gate.sh
      - name: Cross-compile ARM64 array-element field-store witness
        env:
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_COMPILER: /tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-selfhost-linux-x86_64/artifacts/souc-stage2
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_DIR: /tmp/sounio-arm64-array-element-field-witness
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_MODE: attest
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_SOURCE: tests/run-pass/arm64_deref_array_element_field_store.sio
        run: bash scripts/ci/arm64_nested_store_witness_gate.sh
      - name: Cross-compile ARM64 kernel-named-parameter identifier witness
        env:
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_COMPILER: /tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-selfhost-linux-x86_64/artifacts/souc-stage2
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_DIR: /tmp/sounio-arm64-kernel-identifier-witness
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_MODE: attest
          SOUNIO_ARM64_WITNESS_SOURCE: tests/run-pass/arm64_kernel_named_param_identifier.sio
        run: bash scripts/ci/arm64_nested_store_witness_gate.sh
      - name: Source-bootstrap modular typecheck proof
        run: |
          SOUC_STAGE2=/tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-selfhost-linux-x86_64/artifacts/souc-stage2
          CHECK_OUT=/tmp/souc-self-hosted-linux-x86_64-check
          "$SOUC_STAGE2" self-hosted/compiler/lean.sio "$CHECK_OUT"
          chmod +x "$CHECK_OUT"
          "$CHECK_OUT" --help | grep -F -- "--check <source.sio>"
          "$CHECK_OUT" --check tests/run-pass/match_arm_unbraced_assignment.sio
          SOUC_NATIVE="$CHECK_OUT" \
            WORK_DIR=/tmp/sounio-source-bootstrap-native-typecheck-proof \
            bash scripts/selfhost/selfhost_native_typecheck_proof.sh
